name: Joint CMU-Pitt PhD Program in Computational Biology

english.note: Normally less than two years old. No English-test waiver for non-native English speakers, including English-medium/US degrees. US bachelor’s/master’s holders may submit expired scores up to five years old. TOEFL/IELTS preferred; DET only if unable to take them despite best efforts. SCS admitted-score ranges are descriptive, not additional minimums.

applicationFee.note: $80 if applying before November 18, 2026 at 3 pm EST. Financial-hardship/program-participation waiver through application; no US-only limitation stated, international applicants should confirm eligibility.

documents: Uploaded transcripts; official copies after admission
Personal/research statement; SCS generally recommends a concise 1–2-page essay, with program-specific instructions in application
requirements.note: Prior research/publications viewed favorably but not required; prior master’s not required. Backgrounds include physical/biological sciences, math, statistics and engineering; programming/data structures/algorithms remediation may be recommended. Identify at least three potential thesis faculty. Contact optional; faculty cannot promise admission. GRE not required per current program application page despite older FAQ reference. SCS permits up to three doctoral applications; each has separate fee. Letters: At least two faculty or recent employers; online. Follow program complete-by-deadline rule.

funding.note: All enrolled students receive full tuition, stipend and health insurance support; no additional financial-aid application needed. No stipend amount stated.

summary: Joint CMU–Pittsburgh doctoral training in computational biology, with admission through either university.

deadlines.label: Final complete application
deadlines.note: Fall 2027. Program says no exceptions and incomplete applications cannot be evaluated.
